title: Cucurbitacin-E-Glucoside Augments Tamoxifen's Anticancer Efficacy by Targeting PPARgamma and NF-kB: In Vivo and In Silico Studies.
authors: Sabry, Yasmin; Hussein, Mohammed A; Elshal, Mohamed F
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体内实验和分子对接考察葫芦素E葡萄糖苷与PPARgamma和NF-kB的相互作用以增强他莫昔芬抗癌效果，虽涉及转录因子和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白结合而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cucurbitacin-E-glucoside (CEG), a natural compound from the Cucurbitaceae family, has shown anti-proliferative effects on various human cancer cell lines and is believed to inhibit the peroxisome proliferative activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) signaling pathway. We aimed to investigate the anti-cancer effects of CEG in a mouse model of Ehrlich ascites carcinoma (EAC) and its capacity to improve the efficacy of tamoxifen (TAM) treatment. By examining the in vivo and in silico interactions between CEG and tamoxifen with PPARgamma, this study presents a novel approach to cancer management. METHODS: CEG (50 mg/k.g.b.w.) and TAM (20 mg/k.g.b.w.) were administered individually and/or in combination with the EAC-bearing mice. After 4 weeks of treatment, tumor weight and volume were measured. Additionally, inflammation and oxidative stress biomarkers, as well as apoptotic and antiapoptotic genes, were evaluated using ELISA and qRT-PCR. DNA cell cycle analysis of cancer cells was also performed using flow cytometry. To elucidate the molecular mechanism of CEG, PPARgamma and NF-kappaB, the key transcription factor, were studied using Western blot and molecular docking studies. RESULTS: Oral administration of CEG and tamoxifen individually and/or in combination led to significant decreases in tumor volume and weight. Additionally, the drug combination led to significant decreases in the proliferation index S phase and G2 phase. Moreover, treatment of CEG induces the expression of apoptotic PPARalpha and PPARgamma as well as inhibits the expression of antiapoptotic Bcl-2 and HIF-1Alpha genes. Meanwhile, combining CEG with TAM showed a significant increase in liver GSH, CAT, SOD, NP-SH, and protein as well as significant decreases in levels of the plasma inflammatory markers IL-2, IL-6, TGF- beta1, and the angiogenesis marker VEGF-C. Western blot analyses showed that CEG alone induced 2.8-fold PPARgamma upregulation and 1.9-fold NF-kappaB suppression (p < 0.01) compared to the EAC group. Molecular docking analyses of CEG within the ligand-binding domains of the PPARgamma and the inflammation transcription factor NF-KB proteins demonstrated comparable binding affinities to the PPARgamma agonist Rosiglitazone and the NF-KB inhibitor MG-132, corroborating results obtained in vivo. CONCLUSION: Our findings show that CEG therapy activates apoptotic PPARalpha and PPARgamma genes and suppresses anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 and HIF-1Alpha genes, while reducing the oxidative stress and inflammation in EAC cells through a mechanism involving inhibition of NF-kbeta. Finally, CEG creates a safe and synergistic environment that amplifies the therapeutic benefits of tamoxifen.
abstract_zh: 背景：葫芦素E-葡萄糖苷（Cucurbitacin-E-glucoside, CEG）是一种来自葫芦科（Cucurbitaceae）的天然化合物，已显示出对多种人癌细胞系的抗增殖作用，并被认为可抑制过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）信号通路。我们旨在研究CEG在艾氏腹水癌（Ehrlich ascites carcinoma, EAC）小鼠模型中的抗癌作用及其提高他莫昔芬（tamoxifen, TAM）治疗疗效的能力。通过检查CEG和他莫昔芬与PPARgamma的体内和计算机模拟（in silico）相互作用，本研究提出了一种癌症管理的新方法。方法：将CEG（50 mg/k.g.b.w.）和TAM（20 mg/k.g.b.w.）单独和/或联合给予携带EAC的小鼠。治疗4周后，测量肿瘤重量和体积。此外，使用ELISA和qRT-PCR评估炎症和氧化应激生物标志物以及凋亡和抗凋亡基因。还使用流式细胞术对癌细胞进行DNA细胞周期分析。为阐明CEG的分子机制，使用Western blot和分子对接研究研究了PPARgamma和关键转录因子NF-kappaB。结果：口服CEG和他莫昔芬单独和/或联合给药导致肿瘤体积和重量显著减少。此外，药物联合导致增殖指数S期和G2期显著降低。而且，CEG治疗诱导凋亡性PPARalpha和PPARgamma的表达，并抑制抗凋亡Bcl-2和HIF-1Alpha基因的表达。同时，将CEG与TAM联合使用显示肝脏GSH、CAT、SOD、NP-SH和蛋白质显著增加，以及血浆炎症标志物IL-2、IL-6、TGF-beta1和血管生成标志物VEGF-C水平显著降低。Western blot分析显示，与EAC组相比，单独使用CEG诱导PPARgamma上调2.8倍和NF-kappaB抑制1.9倍（p < 0.01）。CEG在PPARgamma和炎症转录因子NF-KB蛋白配体结合域内的分子对接分析显示，其结合亲和力与PPARgamma激动剂罗格列酮（Rosiglitazone）和NF-KB抑制剂MG-132相当，证实了体内获得的结果。结论：我们的研究结果表明，CEG治疗激活凋亡性PPARalpha和PPARgamma基因，并抑制抗凋亡Bcl-2和HIF-1Alpha基因，同时通过涉及抑制NF-kbeta的机制减少EAC细胞中的氧化应激和炎症。最后，CEG创造了一个安全且协同的环境，放大了他莫昔芬的治疗益处。
